# Is the lump sum for my mineral royalties worth taking?

> Free mineral and oil and gas royalty buyout calculator: compare a lump-sum offer with the royalty checks you would keep receiving. Arps decline curve, present value at your discount rate, the buyer's implied return, planned-well upside and an after-tax comparison. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
